title: Brute Force / Credential Stuffing Response Playbook

steps.action: Confirm lockout policy is active. If the attacker IP is still live, block it at the firewall immediately.
If any login SUCCEEDED after the brute force, treat the account as compromised — lock it now.
Review all login attempts: identify targeted usernames, time window, and whether any new sessions were established.
Query AbuseIPDB / VirusTotal for the attacking IP — check known campaigns or ASN abuse history.
Force password reset for all accounts targeted. Enforce MFA if not already active.
Set account lockout after 5 attempts. Enable geo-blocking or rate-limiting on the authentication endpoint.
Document IOCs (IP, usernames, time range). File incident report noting credential-compromise status.
